migration: HeartStrings -> Cordel (HeartStrings Play -> Cordel Play, HeartStrings Connect -> Cordel Connect)
scanScope: Full repository text scan, case-insensitive, excluding node_modules/.git/dist/playwright-report/test-results

active-source-migrated.description: Live website source: src/pages, src/components, src/layouts, src/data, tests/unit, public/_redirects, public architecture SVGs. Fully migrated to Cordel text and renamed routes/files.

active-qa-tooling-migrated.description: Currently-used QA generator scripts re-run to produce ongoing QA output: qa/qa-sweep.mjs, qa/generate-owner-review.mjs, qa/asset-audit/generate-inventory.mjs (dest/role fields only - see residual-allowlist for preserved historical Downloads filenames within generate-inventory.mjs).

generated-qa-artifacts-regenerated.description: qa/owner-review/index.html, qa/owner-review/manifest.json, qa/asset-audit/asset-inventory.html, qa/asset-audit/asset-inventory.json - outputs of the migrated generator scripts, regenerated against the migrated site rather than hand-edited.

legacy-redirect-source-paths.description: public/_redirects: '/heartstrings' and '/heartstrings-app' source paths preserved intentionally as historical inbound URLs; destinations repointed to Cordel routes. New 301s added for every retired canonical /products/heartstrings-play* and /products/heartstrings-connect* route.

historical-one-off-scripts.description: qa/asset-audit/patch-*.mjs, fix-*.mjs, patch-corrective-pass.mjs (17 files) - already-executed one-time patch scripts from a prior asset-ingestion session. Document historical operations performed under the name in effect at the time; not re-run, not rewritten.

historical-ingestion-data.description: qa/asset-audit/ingest-manifest.json, hash-groups.json, contact-sheets/manifest.json - generated records from the same completed ingestion pass, containing literal original Downloads filenames/paths (immutable external files, out of scope to modify) plus historical decisions made under the name in effect at the time. Not linked from qa/owner-review/index.html (confirmed by reading the generator).

historical-narrative-docs.description: ASSET_MANIFEST.md, SITE_FULL_PUBLIC_REDESIGN_AND_DEPLOY_REPORT.md, reports/SITE_ARCHITECTURE_UPDATE_PROOF.txt - narrative records of completed past work sessions, correctly using the brand name in effect when that work was done. Rewriting would falsify history.

baked-in-pixel-branding.description: 5 live-referenced raster images with 'HeartStrings' wordmark rendered directly into pixels (box front/back, guides banner, companion-screen hero, one AIya interface screenshot). No editable source layers or approved Cordel artwork exist (confirmed: C:\Downloads, C:\Users\tbroa\Downloads, D:\Download, D:\Downloads all searched for '*ordel*' - zero results). Cannot be corrected without fabricating a final Cordel product render, which is prohibited. Moved to qa/cordel-migration/blocked-legacy-assets/ (unservable, out of public/) and replaced on their pages with the site's existing '.asset-ph' typographic placeholder pattern.

unused-baked-in-pixel-branding-not-yet-r.description: public/cordel/cordel-play-board-spec-diagram.webp, public/cordel/cordel-app-signup.png, public/cordel/screenshots/01_login.png, public/cordel/screenshots/02_signup.png - confirmed via direct visual inspection to have baked-in 'HeartStrings' wordmark, but NOT currently referenced from any src/ page (orphan static files, not part of the browsable site). Left in place under public/cordel/ since they are not presently displayed anywhere; flagged so they are not wired into a future page without being resolved first.
unused-baked-in-pixel-branding-not-yet-r.recommendation: Move to blocked-legacy-assets/ or delete before any future page links to them.

unsampled-screenshot-pool.description: public/cordel/screenshots/ contains ~50 real captured app screenshots total; 7 are wired into live pages (all checked - 6 clean, 1 blocked, see baked-in-pixel-branding). The remaining ~43 were not individually inspected (out of scope - not referenced by any page). Sampling of auth/onboarding-named files (01_login, 02_signup) vs deep-app-screen files (06_matches, 12_game_room) showed a consistent pattern: onboarding/auth screens carry the baked-in wordmark, deep app screens do not.
unsampled-screenshot-pool.recommendation: Apply the same visual-inspection gate as this pass before ever wiring an unsampled screenshot into a page.
